address: Avenida Infante Dom Henrique, Rio de Janeiro, 20021-140, Brazil
bio: The name of this restaurant is a reference to the famous Argentinian tango “A Media Luz”, while the number 348 corresponds to the number of the street where the first of the brand’s ventures opened in Greater São Paulo. It overlooks the Marina da Glória, hence the spectacular views from tables on the terrace, and features several spacious dining rooms and an extensive glass-fronted wine cellar. The culinary focus is of course on Argentina and choice cuts of meats cooked on the grill, including specialities such as ribeye, centre cut ribeye, filet mignon with garlic, chorizo sausage and top sirloin, all accompanied by sides designed for sharing. To finish, the “dulce de leche” pancake served with sorbet is an authentic Argentinian dessert that is truly irresistible....
